findings.problem: The flatness-of-sections argument is a private copy of an existing, exported theorem. The argument is: the flat property gives `appLE ⊤ U` flat, `ΓSpecIso.inv` is bijective and so flat, and the composite is flat, which is `Module.Flat` for the `algebraOfHom` structure. The same proof is also pasted as `flat_sections` in many other Sol files (for example `CocAux` and `OB4aGlue`). The statement here is identical to `AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.TwoAffineOpenCover.flat_sections_of_flat`, which `S_AlgebraicGeometry_SmallExtension_exists_pointDerivations_two_cochain_of_isTangentCoordsOfPairAtVia_pin` already imports and uses. The local copy is therefore a thin restatement that has to be kept in sync with the shared one.
findings.proposed_change: Delete `TwistPairAux.flat_sections`. Add `import Theorems.Thm_AlgebraicGeometry_Scheme_TwoAffineOpenCover_flat_sections_of_flat`. Replace the use `flat_sections qa (Oa (Ua ⊓ Ub)) hOaffa` with `AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.TwoAffineOpenCover.flat_sections_of_flat qa (Oa (Ua ⊓ Ub)) hOaffa`. The argument order `(c) (U) (hU)` is the same as the local lemma, and the instance `[Flat c]` is already supplied through `hqa : Smooth qa`.
findings.benefit: This removes one more copy of the proof (the same body appears in several other files) and leaves one place to maintain. Readers no longer have to check that each local `flat_sections` agrees with the shared statement.

findings.problem: The identity `hU.fromSpec ≫ q = Spec.map (algebraMap …)` is a small but non-routine calculation. It rewrites the `algebraOfHom` ring map as `ΓSpecIso.inv ≫ q.appLE ⊤ U _` and then applies `SpecMap_appLE_fromSpec`. It is re-proved from scratch in at least eight Sol files: `CocAux`, `OB4aGlue`, `CocAux` in the `d_two_cochain…_pin` file, `unitPullback_obstruction…`, `exists_injective_isTangentOfPair_of_flat`, the RelPicard files and others. Each copy uses a different local name and a different argument convention (`U` implicit or explicit, `fromSpec_comp_eq_specMap`). There is no shared version in `Definitions/` or `Theorems/`, even though a shared `flat_sections_of_flat` already exists for the sibling fact.
findings.proposed_change: Add one shared theorem next to `flat_sections_of_flat`, for example `AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.TwoAffineOpenCover.fromSpec_comp_eq_specMap`. Its statement is the one at lines 27–29: for `q : Y ⟶ Spec (CommRingCat.of T')`, `U` and `hU : IsAffineOpen U`, with `letI := algebraOfHom q U`, `hU.fromSpec ≫ q = Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap T' Γ(Y, U)))`. The proof is the existing body from lines 30–33. Then delete `TwistPairAux` here. The call sites `fromSpec_comp_eq qa (Oa (Ua ⊓ Ub)) hOaffa` and `fromSpec_comp_eq qb (Ob (Ua ⊓ Ub)) hOaffb` are unchanged, apart from the new name. Switch the other Sol files to the shared lemma in the same way, reconciling the implicit/explicit `U` convention.
findings.benefit: The proof is stated once and tested once instead of being copied across the Sol files. Later changes to `algebraOfHom` or to the Mathlib `SpecMap_appLE_fromSpec` API need one fix instead of many. The target file shrinks to its real content, the overlap-isomorphism construction.
